description:
Cast Sage of Hours by paying {1}{U}.
Sage of Hours entering the battlefield triggers Remnant of the Rising Star, causing you to pay {5} to put five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, taking at least one extra turn after this one.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sage of Hours from the battlefield to your hand and giving Temur Sabertooth indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat each turn.

uses.name: Jugan Defends the Temple // Remnant of the Rising Star
